data.title: US federal agents search home of Trump critic Ilhan Omar
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US federal agents searched the Washington home of Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar on Monday as part of a criminal investigation, officials said, marking a dramatic escalation in President Donald Trump's confrontation with the outspoken lawmaker.

data.title: Pope to enter hospital for lung operation
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV will be admitted to hospital on Tuesday morning for an operation to remove a lump from his lung, the Vatican said.

data.title: UK retains early access to test latest US AI models
data.description: LONDON - Britain has retained early access to the latest artificial intelligence models for safety testing, the country's AI minister confirmed Monday, following reports that the White House had restricted the UK's access.

data.title: Saudi says resilience tested, vows response after deadly airport attacks
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Saudi Arabia's energy minister on Monday said the country had been tested but would mount a "serious" response after a string of attacks on Riyadh's international airport by Yemen's Houthis that left 18 people dead.

data.title: French supermarket chains say cyberattack forced refrigerator shutdown
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Major French supermarket chains Intermarche and Cooperative U were hit by a cyberattack that caused their refrigerators to defrost, the two retailers reported Monday.

data.title: Top NATO commander warns Russia any attack would be 'futile'
data.description: WARSAW - NATO's top military commander said Monday the alliance would "block, blunt, and break" any attack on its members, in a warning to Russia as fears grow over the threat from Moscow.

data.title: UNHCR sounds alarm on funding crisis
data.description: GENEVA - The UN refugees chief warned Monday about being "asked to do the impossible", with his agency over-stretched by a huge funding shortfall and heavy displacement.

data.title: Stolen Renoir paintings found behind wall in France: prosecutor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Two paintings by impressionist master Pierre-Auguste Renoir, stolen from a museum in southern France and later discovered hidden behind a wall, have sustained slight damage, prosecutors said on Monday.

data.title: France schools protest rumbles on as Macron urges 'respect'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Some 130 French high schools remained closed on Monday, the education ministry said, with authorities hoping the protest movement that has rocked the nation in recent weeks would ease ahead of half-term holidays.

data.title: Americans Hall and Woodford win economics Nobel for stabilisation models
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Americans Robert Hall and Michael Woodford were awarded the Nobel economics prize Monday for their work on how monetary and fiscal policy can better stabilise disruptive economic fluctuations.

data.title: Hurricane Simon lashes Mexico's Pacific coast, threatens US landfall
data.description: MIAMI - Hurricane Simon lashed Mexico's Pacific coast with severe winds and heavy rain on Monday, as it threatens to make landfall in the United States this week, according to the country's National Hurricane Center.

data.title: Zelensky vows to respond as Moscow silent on 'energy ceasefire'
data.description: WARSAW - Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday his country would respond if Russia did not agree to the "energy ceasefire" announced by US President Donald Trump.

data.title: Minister's resignation rocks German coalition
data.description: BERLIN - German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's government faced new turbulence on Monday when a key minister from its junior coalition partner unexpectedly quit and criticised "attacks" from the chancellor's party.

data.title: Thousands march in India's capital to demand election chief resign
data.description: NEW DELHI - Thousands of protesters marched in New Delhi on Monday demanding the resignation of India's election chief over alleged misconduct during a voter roll revision, the latest showdown with authorities in the heavily fortified capital.

data.title: Central Pattana highlights robust office portfolio, celebrates successful first year of Central Park Offices
data.description: Showcases a portfolio of 11 office buildings in prime locations across Bangkok, offering over 400,000 sq.m. of leasable space and consistently maintaining an average portfolio occupancy rate of over 90%.

data.title: Radware Launches New Cloud Security Service Centre in Thailand
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand – October 8, 2026 – Radware (NASDAQ: RDWR), a global provider of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions, is expanding its presence in Thailand with the launch of a new Cloud Security Service Centre connected to the company’s global Cloud Security network.

data.title: 10,000 tonnes of flood-trash cleared from Bangkok streets
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has already collected more than 10,000 tonnes of post-flood garbage as the water retreats across the capital, with a "Buddy District" task force accelerating recovery efforts.

data.title: Arkadia-Life brings the 911 into your living room for US$30,000
data.description: The latest launch from Chinese design brand Arkadia-Life, the P01 Classic Sofa, compresses a long-hood Porsche 911 into a single-seater sofa for motor enthusiasts looking to bring the look of the iconic sports care into their living room.

data.title: The Weeknd concertgoers in Bangkok stunned by suspected faeces
data.description: A suspected defecation during a concert by international artist The Weeknd in Bangkok has sparked widespread discussion on social media, with attendees reportedly discovering the waste on the stadium floor.

data.title: Call for adventure tourism accountability after 2 tourists injured
data.description: PHETCHABUN - Phetchabun authorities face calls to review adventure tourism safety rules and compliance after two foreigners were injured in a fall from a cliff while abseiling over the weekend.

data.title: Korean wanted for child porn distribution arrested in Bangkok
data.description: Police were able to find and detain a 42-year-old South Korean man at a condominium in Bangkok wanted in his home country for allegedly distributing pornographic videos of teenage girls online.

data.title: Koh Samui villa hit by landslide
data.description: SURAT THANI: A villa on Koh Samui was reported hit by landslide on Monday with local administrators warning of more due to rain-soaked soil.

data.title: Jim Thompson goes 'Wild' in Bill Bensley collab
data.description: Jim Thompson has joined creative forces with architect, interior designer, artist and landscape architect Bill Bensley to launch Wild, an exclusive collection inspired by the wildlife and stories of the rainforests in Southeast Asia.

data.title: Dusit Thani Hua Hin Unveils ‘The Art of Celebration’ Festive Season
data.description: Hua Hin, Thailand – October 2026 – Dusit Thani Hua Hin will celebrate Christmas and welcome 2027 with The Art of Celebration, a festive programme running from December 24, 2026, to January 1, 2027. Bringing together the resort’s beachfront setting and distinct dining venues, the programme spans Christmas Eve dinners, Christmas Day brunch and Italian dining, followed by two New Year’s Eve celebrations, fireworks and a relaxed start to the new year.

data.title: Progressive team takes control of Social Security Board
data.description: The Progressive Social Security team has taken control of the Social Security Office Board with a dominating win over their rivals in Sunday's election.

data.title: France's high school students plan fresh protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France's high school students on Monday begin a new stage of their campaign for improved conditions, hoping to maintain the momentum with a fresh wave of demonstrations.

data.title: NZ bank in free speech row over 'explicit' sheep memes
data.description: WELLINGTON - A bank in New Zealand has found itself at the centre of an unlikely free speech row after an attempt to remove "explicit" memes about its sheep mascot from social media.

data.title: Italian rice farmer beats heat with biodiversity haven
data.description: CROVA (ITALY) - Four hundred years after monks transformed a patch of marshlands in northwest Italy into rice fields, farmer Alice Cerutti has restored a third to their natural state, prioritising biodiversity over crop yield.

data.title: Opposition, journalists allege police abuses during India protests
data.description: NEW DELHI - Opposition leaders and journalists accused police of heavy-handed tactics during weekend demonstrations, as authorities locked down New Delhi on Monday ahead of a fresh rally against the election chief.

data.title: The 1’s Gen Z gym membership buyers rise eightfold in 3 years
data.description: The 1’s Gen Z members spend more on sport than travel, with buyer numbers doubling for healthy snacks and alternative drinks over three years.

data.title: Bangkok Bar Show returns
data.description: Bangkok Bar Show returns on Oct 24–25 at Anantara Siam Bangkok, bringing together the bar and beverage community for two days of spirits, cocktails, education and hospitality in the heart of Bangkok.

data.title: Melbourne man linked to suspected flydubai hijacker condemns 'false accusations'
data.description: SYDNEY - A Melbourne man whose Islamic community centre has been linked by prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates to the co-pilot who allegedly attacked the captain of a flydubai jet has hit out at "false accusations".
